description: This file defines the PromiseInterface within the GuzzleHttpomise namespace. It specifies the interface for asynchronous promise objects, including methods for attaching callbacks, checking state, resolving, rejecting, canceling, and waiting on promises.

classes.name: PromiseInterface
classes.description: Interface for representing a promise of an asynchronous operation's result, including methods for handling fulfillment, rejection, cancellation, and state queries.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Attaches fulfillment and rejection handlers, returning a new promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Attaches rejection handler, returning a new promise.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise ('pending', 'fulfilled', or 'rejected').

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the promise with a specific value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a reason.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the promise execution.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the promise is settled and returns the result or throws an exception.
